name: GitHub Copilot SDK — via Foundry project endpoint
summary: Copilot SDK BYOK provider pointed at the Foundry project /openai/v1/ URL with a `{conn}/{model}` BYOM prefix in the model field.
description: The GitHub Copilot SDK (github/copilot-sdk) supports BYOK against OpenAI-compatible endpoints. If you point it at the Foundry **project-level** endpoint (`{project_endpoint}/openai/v1/`) and pass `model="{apim-conn}/{deployment}"`, Foundry should parse the prefix and route to the APIM connection the same way it does for direct Responses API calls. Auth path is static-credential only (`apiKey` or `bearerToken`), so Entra flows require a caller-managed refresh loop.
notes: **Gotcha**: the byok.md sample uses `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai/v1/` — that's the account-level AOAI endpoint and has NO knowledge of Foundry connections, so BYOM prefixes will 404 there. Must use the project URL, e.g. `https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>/openai/v1/`. **Auth**: `bearerToken` accepts a static string only — the SDK never refreshes. Workable pattern: run a background thread that grabs a fresh Entra token (`az account get-access-token --resource https://ai.azure.com`) ~5 min before expiry and recreates the session. **Requires** `wire_api: "responses"`. **Unverified**: whether `model="{conn}/{deployment}"` survives Copilot SDK client-side validation → JSON-RPC → CLI → Responses API without being stripped/rejected. Needs a probe.
